title: Restriction weight under coordinate projection
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $g$ be any real-valued function on restriction assignments to $|J|$ coordinates. Under the product weights that assign weight $\delta$ to a free coordinate and $(1-\delta)/2$ to either fixed value, the weighted sum over all assignments on the full coordinate set of $g$ applied to their restrictions on $J$ equals the weighted sum of $g$ over all assignments on $J$.
hypotheses_covered: δ is an arbitrary real number
J is a finite subset of the n coordinates
g is a real-valued function on assignments of |J| coordinate restrictions
